name: Valerio Giacosa
original_name: ヴァレリオ・ジアコーザ
source:
Valerio keeps spirits in Argus high with the chipper, upbeat personality typical of Italians. He has a habit of chasing after any girl he sees, but he’s also caring and works hard to reduce tensions within the unit. His nickname is VG. He learned to pilot at TSF on the European front, and became quite good at it. His ability to read a situation, and his skill as a TSF pilot, make him a valued member of the team.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
